methodology: Editorial comparison of 40 individual scoped Lean result families based on theorem depth, generality and relevance to open mathematical obligations, not mathematical novelty or a theorem-completion score. Only public-source entries are displayed, while private-source entries count toward the global ranking.

entries.title: Orbital stability of the minimizing set
entries.summary: For the fourth-order cubic–quintic Schrödinger flow on H²(ℝ²), solutions initially near the minimizing set remain near it for all time.
entries.limit: β, γ > 0 and 0 < m ≤ mB. Stability is of the set, not each wave profile; no physical-particle identification.
entries.equation_note: The theorem concerns orbital stability for this exact flow on the stated mass interval.

entries.title: Existence and compactness of whole-space minimizers
entries.summary: Proves minimizer existence and strong H² compactness of minimizing sequences modulo translations for the stated mass range.
entries.limit: Same specific cubic–quintic model and bounded mass range. Does not establish uniqueness, radial symmetry, or a derivation from S004.
entries.equation_note: Minimization is subject to the fixed mass integral ∫|ψ|² dx = m.

entries.title: Strict mass binding for fourth-order confined states
entries.summary: For every 0 < μ < m in the explicit range 0 < m ≤ mB, the constrained minimum obeys I(m) < I(μ) + I(m − μ), ruling out energetic favorability of any such mass split.
entries.limit: Assumes the specified two-dimensional cubic–quintic Hamiltonian and β, γ > 0; the all-splits theorem is not asserted for arbitrary mass or the original higher-time-derivative S004 action.
entries.equation_note: The strict inequality is proved only for the stated cubic–quintic model and explicit mass range.

entries.title: Global nonlinear flow and conservation laws
entries.summary: Global well-posedness, continuous dependence and mass/energy conservation for the defined H²(ℝ²) cubic–quintic evolution.
entries.limit: Applies to the stated equation, not every fourth-order nonlinear PDE.
entries.equation_note: The conservation laws apply to the specified global H² solutions.

entries.title: Regular higher-derivative Ostrogradsky obstruction
entries.summary: For the regular acceleration-Hessian class, the canonical Hamiltonian is unbounded above and below when the velocity is nonzero.
entries.limit: A class-wide canonical obstruction, not a proof that all higher-derivative theories are unstable.
entries.equation_label: Regular acceleration Lagrangian and Ostrogradsky Hamiltonian
entries.equation_note: The energy is unbounded under the theorem's regularity and nonzero-velocity hypotheses.

entries.title: Exact S004 regular-sector constraint and degree-of-freedom count
entries.summary: Formal Dirac constraint analysis gives a 12-dimensional phase space, four second-class constraints and four configuration degrees of freedom, together with a canonical energy-unboundedness result.
entries.limit: Applies on the regular nonnodal patch of the specified flat-background S004 complex scalar with the stated parameter assumptions; exceptional nodal sectors and a healthy parent theory are not resolved.
entries.equation_note: Here ρ = |ψ|² and F(ρ) = ρ/(ρ + ε²e^(−2αρ))². The constraint theorem applies to the regular field sector.

entries.title: Dimension-dependent Sobolev classification
entries.summary: Certifies localized gradient-energy estimates and dimension-dependent counterexamples, including H² failures above dimension four.
entries.limit: A precise estimate classification, not proof that physical space must be four-dimensional.
entries.equation_note: The uniform all-fields, all-radii H¹ inequality is classified by spatial dimension.

entries.title: Twenty-dimensional local non-identifiability
entries.summary: The frozen 31-parameter forward model has derivative rank 11, nullity 20, and distinct nearby equal-output parameter values.
entries.limit: Local result for the frozen exact-decimal model; does not classify distant fibers or arbitrary models.
entries.equation_note: The equation describes the source's frozen forward-observation model in an open ambient parameter chart.

entries.title: High-regularity bound for corrected curvature
entries.summary: Proves a uniform-in-space bound for the specified corrected regularized curvature operator in Fourier-defined Sobolev spaces.
entries.limit: Requires positive regularization and regularity s > n/2 + 2; not an unregularized physical curvature theorem.
entries.equation_note: For ε > 0 the denominator is positive; the L∞ theorem assumes sufficiently high Sobolev regularity.

entries.title: Ultraviolet ill-posedness of a specified flow
entries.summary: Establishes high-frequency growth and Sobolev ill-posedness for the specified higher-time-derivative dynamics.
entries.limit: An obstruction for the encoded model, not a general no-go theorem for all fourth-order equations.
entries.equation_note: This is the theorem's specified illustrative model, not a universal dispersion law for WCT.

entries.title: Exact Lyapunov dissipation identity
entries.summary: Connects the Fréchet derivative of the energy to exact monotone descent along stated gradient-flow solutions.
entries.limit: Assumes a sufficiently regular solution of the specified gradient flow; does not prove that such a solution exists.
entries.equation_label: Curvature energy and associated gradient flow
entries.equation_note: F(s) = s/(s + ε²e^(−2αs))². The proof assumes a sufficiently regular trajectory of the defined gradient flow.

entries.title: Original S004 action to strong Euler–Lagrange bridge
entries.summary: Proves a conditional bridge from the true nonlinear integrated S004 action derivative to the two-component strong Euler expressions in 1+1 dimensions, including the measure-theoretic and Green-identity steps.
entries.limit: ActionRegularity, GreenRegularity, time-endpoint and periodic trace assumptions remain explicit analytic premises. This is not a ghost-free completion or unconditional physical PDE theorem.
entries.equation_label: Strong Euler–Lagrange equation of the corrected S004 action
entries.equation_note: Here uₐ is either real component of ψ. Lean proves a conditional integrated action-to-strong variation identity, not unrestricted existence.

entries.title: Instantaneous nonlinear Fourier leakage
entries.summary: Proves immediate nonlinear leakage and a classification of invariant Fourier-support subspaces for the stated flow.
entries.limit: Model-specific Fourier-invariance result; not a claim that all coherent wave packets delocalize.
entries.equation_note: The right side is the fifth-order nonlinear contribution for the specified two-mode initial support.

entries.title: Controlled false-positive rate for photodiode PASS
entries.summary: Proves P(classify = PASS) ≤ α for the frozen blinded randomization protocol under the exact conditional null model.
entries.limit: Requires the sharp null and uniform conditional assignment; does not establish a physical persistent-memory effect.
entries.equation_note: PASS additionally requires both control comparisons to satisfy their frozen statistical and effect-size thresholds.

entries.title: Scalar-gradient metric rank and degeneracy obstruction
entries.summary: For a metric constructed as the real Gram tensor of one complex scalar's differential, proves positivity, covariance and rank ≤ 2; on four-dimensional tangent spaces this yields nullity ≥ 2.
entries.limit: Applies to this specified scalar-gradient metric construction, not every scalar-derived spacetime metric or the existence of physical gravity.
entries.equation_note: For a four-dimensional real tangent space, the Gram tensor is necessarily degenerate.

entries.title: Fourth-order self-adjoint operator and semigroup
entries.summary: Certifies self-adjointness, the mild evolution, exact semigroup norm and off-shell damping for the quartic selector.
entries.limit: Linear operator theorem; nonlinear confinement is separate.
entries.equation_note: The self-adjoint generator and exact semigroup are established on the stated L² and H⁴ domains.

entries.title: Preferred Fourier-shell concentration
entries.summary: Certifies convergence of the preferred-wavenumber spectral peak with a quantitative rate for the specified linear flow.
entries.limit: Growth and shell selection do not, alone, prove a localized nonlinear soliton.
entries.equation_label: Band-pass evolution and preferred Fourier shell
entries.equation_note: The actual concentration theorem requires initial spectral access and b > 0; the earlier E16SpectralCore module proves only the growth algebra.

entries.title: Swift–Hohenberg spectral characterization
entries.summary: Derives the spectrum and sharp semigroup growth regimes for the specified fourth-order generator.
entries.limit: Linear spectral statement, not a nonlinear stability theorem.
entries.equation_note: The exact continuum spectrum and norm of the generated semigroup are proved for a > 0.

entries.title: Opposite-energy S004 mode decomposition
entries.summary: Shows that positive real squared frequencies can coexist with opposite-sign mode energies and unbounded Hamiltonian energy.
entries.limit: Applies to the stated S004 real-pole mode window and canonical reduction.
entries.equation_latex: L=-\frac K2\ddot x^{\,2}+\frac A2\dot x^{\,2}-\frac B2x^2,\qquad Kx^{(4)}+A\ddot x+Bx=0
entries.equation_note: Its normal-mode decomposition exhibits opposite-sign energies for distinct real frequencies.

entries.title: Continuous and discrete Fourier band projectors
entries.summary: Formalizes orthogonal spectral-band projection and associated energy-fraction identities.
entries.limit: Does not imply observed wavelength selection in an experiment.
entries.equation_latex: \widehat{P_{\mathcal B}u}(k)=\mathbf1_{\mathcal B}(k)\widehat u(k),\qquad P_{\mathcal B}^2=P_{\mathcal B}=P_{\mathcal B}^{*}
entries.equation_note: The squared-norm ratio measures the fraction of spectral energy within the selected band.

entries.title: Sharp fourth-order resolvent control
entries.summary: Proves the sharp resolvent norm, coercivity and band selectivity for the specified operator.
entries.limit: Operator estimate only; nonlinear modes require separate proofs.
entries.equation_note: For r > 0, the operator's L² inverse norm equals 1/r.

entries.title: Restricted nodal-sector ghost classification
entries.summary: Classifies bounded energy in nodal sectors invariant under the designated momentum translations.
entries.limit: Does not complete the secondary Dirac constraint algorithm or classify every nodal sector.
entries.equation_note: On the source-defined nodal primary surface, p₁-translation-invariant sectors have bounded energy precisely when velocities vanish.

entries.title: Corrected curvature regularization bound
entries.summary: Certifies H²-based regularized-curvature control, counterexamples and explicit regularization dependence.
entries.limit: Conditional on the specified ε > 0 regularization and functional-analytic premises.
entries.equation_note: Not the corrected modulus-squared M2 operator. The L² bound additionally requires a positive lower separation of |D|.

entries.title: Whole-space curvature nonattainment
entries.summary: Establishes nonattainment and a spreading direction for a specified curvature-energy variational problem.
entries.limit: Does not rule out minimizing states for different Hamiltonians.
entries.equation_note: At every positive fixed mass the infimum is zero and is not attained for the theorem's parameter range.

entries.title: Exact isolated Fourier-shell exclusion
entries.summary: Proves that a nonzero whole-space L² field cannot be supported on a single measure-zero Fourier sphere.
entries.limit: Does not exclude finite-band wave packets or nonlinear confined configurations.
entries.equation_label: Free-space Helmholtz and isolated Fourier-shell equation
entries.equation_note: Such an L² function must vanish. The source also proves the distributional-support version.

entries.title: Exact randomization-test validity
entries.summary: Establishes exact p-value control under finite uniform assignment or a defined exchangeability action.
entries.limit: Assumptions about randomization or exchangeability are essential; physical spectral bins need not be exchangeable.
entries.equation_note: Type-I validity requires the formal exchangeability or sharp-null randomization assumptions.

entries.title: Injective WaveLock message encoding
entries.summary: Establishes injective admissible-message padding and associated block/byte packing properties.
entries.limit: Does not establish a collision-resistant digest, one-way function, or cryptographic security.
entries.equation_note: Here z = (192 − (|m| + 1) mod 192) mod 192. Injectivity is for the pre-round packed input encoding, not the hash digest.

entries.title: Weighted continuous phase-locking minimum
entries.summary: Establishes an exact weighted closed-loop minimum in the specified H¹ phase model.
entries.limit: Does not itself prove a nonlinear physical locking mechanism.
entries.equation_note: Its exact minimum is Δₙ²/(∫₀^S w(s)⁻¹ ds), with Δₙ = 2πn − m∫Ω − ∫σ.
